decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the single-storey rear extension and roof extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted first floor rear extension have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (1013 PA01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06 and 11 received 06.07.1, 1015-PA 07B, 09B and 11 A received 04.10.10, 1015-PA10C received 13.10.10) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the flanks of the first floor rear extension shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards to prevent a view to neighbouring properties and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in either flank wall of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extensions hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single-storey rear extension, first floor rear extension, the construction of a roof extension to the side of the building, the installation of roof lights and a Juliet balcony.
